title: Missing Midnight Pudding
intro: Mako's victory pudding vanished from the fridge at 2 am. Everyone's a suspect, but only one left a trail.

clues.name: Energy Drink Can
clues.desc: An empty can of Nia's favorite brand, crushed, next to the fridge.

clues.name: Pudding Cup
clues.desc: An empty pudding cup in the trash, spoon still inside, licked clean.

clues.name: Game Controller
clues.desc: A controller on the couch, paused at 2:17 am, with sticky pudding residue.

clues.name: Coffee Grounds
clues.desc: Fresh coffee grounds in the sink, but Mocha's cafe is closed until 5 am.

statements.text: I was coding all night with headphones on. I never even went to the kitchen.
I don't even like sweets. Energy drinks are my fuel.
That pudding? Mako probably ate it herself to mess with us.
I baked that pudding for the contest. I went to bed at 11. I didn't touch it.
If I wanted it, I'd have eaten it in front of everyone. I'm not sneaky.
I was asleep until 5. I only came up because I smelled coffee.
That coffee in the sink? Not mine. I brew in the cafe, not upstairs.

confession: Okay, fine. I got hungry at 2 am. The pudding was right there. I'm weak.
wrapup: The controller gave you away, Nia. Next time, eat before you game.

clues.name: Flour Handprint

clues.name: Timer Setting

statements.text: I was coding all night. Didn't leave my room until noon.
I don't even like muffins. Too crumbly.
I never touched the scale. I always eyeball ingredients.
I set the timer correctly. Someone must have changed it.

confession: Fine, I ate them! I was stress-baking and they smelled too good. I'll make more, okay?
wrapup: Case closed. Mako's competitive nature extends to muffin quality control.

statements.text: I was coding until 2am with headphones on. I didn't leave my apartment.
